title: Putnanja
desc: Putnanja, a poor farmer, falls in love with Roja, a city-bred woman. They get married despite opposition from her mother, but differences soon crop up between them.

title: Boxing Parampare
desc: Kabila, a professional boxer, enters a boxing match against a member of a rival gang and begins to train vigorously. But will he emerge victorious?

title: Shravani Subramanya
desc: Subramanya, an aspiring singer, comes to Shravani's rescue when she discovers that her boyfriend Sudeep is a notorious criminal.

title: Doddmane Hudga
desc: Surya, estranged from his wealthy family after being ignored by his father, returns years later to protect their land from a vile villain.

title: Agnyaathavaasi
desc: A billionaire's son returns after his father's death and joins the company as a regular employee in order to nab the people responsible for his father's murder.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kari Gooli
desc: After suffering mercilessly under the reign of a ruthless tycoon, the villagers find hope in a Jallikattu bull trainer, who locks horns with the tycoon.

title: Autograph Please
desc: A man contracts HIV because of an affair with a bar girl prior to his wedding. However, he decides to live normally and encourages other HIV patients to brave the ordeal.
